description: This PHP source file defines the ViewResetmodule class, which handles resetting various customizations (fields, layouts, relationships, labels, extensions) for a module within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for displaying the reset interface, processing reset actions, and removing specific customizations.

classes.name: ViewResetmodule
classes.description: A class extending SugarView that provides functionality to reset custom fields, layouts, relationships, labels, and extensions for a module in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns parameters for the module title, including the module name and title.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the reset module interface, including breadcrumbs and options.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Processes the reset actions based on user input and updates the module accordingly.

methods.name: removeCustomFields
methods.description: Removes all custom fields created in Studio for the module.

methods.name: removeCustomLayouts
methods.description: Removes metadata files for all known studio layouts of the module.

methods.name: removeCustomRelationships
methods.description: Removes all custom relationships involving the module.

methods.name: removeCustomLabels
methods.description: Removes language label files for the module.

methods.name: removeCustomExtensions
methods.description: Clears extension files for the module and rebuilds extensions.
